verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, so automated AI review of pull requests is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence shows automatic PR review or AI-generated inline comments. The GitHub README says semantic reviews are explicit project checks outside merge and that merge launches no models and chooses no reviewers. The GitHub integration only covers bringing issues into kanban, not reviewing pull requests.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments
